chunks: Yūnus, from Samāʿah, from Abī Baṣīr, who said:
“ʿAlī عليه السلام used to flog the free man, the slave, the Jew, and the Christian eighty lashes for wine and nabīdh.”
So I said, “What is the case of the Jew and the Christian?” He said, “If they manifest that in a city among the cities, because they do not have the right to manifest drinking it.”

key_terms.أَظْهَرُوا: they made it public or openly displayed it
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam ʿAlī, peace be upon him
key_terms.يَجْلِدُ: administers flogging as a legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the punishment for publicly drinking intoxicants, including by Jews and Christians, in Muslim cities?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام enforced the hadd of eighty lashes for intoxicants upon different classes of people, including non-Muslims, when the act was openly manifested. It clarifies that the ruling concerning Jews and Christians applies when they publicly display drinking in Muslim towns, since they are not permitted to make such drinking public there.
